text:
incident-bot: ALERT: high_latency_p95 (us-west) > 400ms for 7m — auto-pager triggered
pagerduty-bot: Paging: @maria (oncall) — please investigate high P95 in us-west cluster
maria (oncall): ack. seeing backend generation queue growth and a handful of 502s. routing fallback engaged for some tenant IDs.
eli: i'm online, i'll be secondary for this shift. want me to take customer-facing followups?
maria (oncall): pls. eli you are secondary. samir you're infra lead, hana handle comms.
samir: on it. quick telemetry check: gpud-serve-04 shows long tail latency, batch wait time high. KV cache eviction spikes too.
maria (oncall): noted. rough impact: ~3-6% error/timeout rate, p95 peaked ~820ms in a short window. mostly affected long-context generate routes.
hana: grabbing affected list & preparing a soft notification template. will hold until we know extent.
eli: can we avoid multiple repeat pages? last handoff was noisy. propose: temporarily relax p95 rule to 600ms for 25m and add a one-time suppression tag.
maria (oncall): agree. do that and document in the alert note that it's a manual handoff mitigation.
samir: applying suppression now.
```
alertsctl set latency_p95_uswest --threshold=600 --suppress=25m --note="temp handoff suppression, reduce noise" --tags=hand-off
```
incident-bot: NOTE: suppression applied to latency_p95_uswest until +25m. origin: manual oncall action.
maria (oncall): runbook link: https://runbook.internal/redwood/inference/latency-handling — follow the "spin extra pool" section
eli: i'll stand up an extra gen pool (gen-pool-hot-05) and route heavy routes there. ETA ~3m.
samir: concurrently bumping gpud-serve batch concurrency 72 -> 104 as temporary. watching mem and tail latencies.
hana: drafted customer note:
"We detected a transient increase in request latency in US-West. We've deployed additional capacity and adjusted routing; most customers should be back to normal. We'll follow up if there's sustained impact."
maria (oncall): good. eli confirm pool healthy and routing changes applied?
eli: gen-pool-hot-05 ready, traffic shifted, traces show improved tail. p95 down to ~330ms and 5xxs trending down.
samir: KV miss rate also decreasing; queue length back to baseline. recommend keep suppression for 15 more min then revert slowly.
manual-note: samir updated alert metadata with tag=hand-off and actor=samir
incident-bot: alert metadata updated (hand-off). suppression extended per manual request.
maria (oncall): hana, send the soft notice to affected list. keep phrasing non-alarming and include contact link.
hana: sent. no replies yet.
eli: will monitor traces and call if anything spikes. also leaving a quick mitigation blurb in ops notes: extra pool + batch tweak.
maria (oncall): create a post-incident task to tune kernel selection and batch limiter to avoid queue buildup on long contexts. include cost delta if we change thresholds permanently.
samir: created RED-PIA-4620 and assigned to infra + runtime teams: https://issues.internal/RED-PIA-4620
maria (oncall): thanks. i'll re-open alerts to baseline once metrics stable. plan: wait 15m, then remove suppression and set threshold back to 420ms.
eli: agree. i'll be on standby as secondary for next 2 hours.
maria (oncall): team roles for handoff window: maria primary, eli secondary, samir infra, hana comms. note this in rotation doc.
hana: noted and updated rotation doc.
incident-bot: Incident resolved by oncall: short summary: transient p95 spike due to batching + KV pressure; mitigated by adding capacity and temp alert adjustment. follow-up: RED-PIA-4620."
